filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window ≈ Sat Oct 10 – Mon Oct 12 PT (weekend + Monday morning)

market_briefing.lede: Revenue agents are getting write access to the systems sellers and RevOps run on, and vendors are drawing the boundary in the product. Monday's launches scope each agent action to the signed-in user's permissions, tag every write in the audit trail, and ship skills bundled with the connectors they need.

bullets.text: Scoped writes: Qobra's MCP went native in Dust (Oct 12) with 65 actions, 45 read and 20 write, across quotas, plans, records and requests. Each action runs under the user's own Qobra permissions, every write is logged as an MCP action, and agents never edit statements or payouts.

Skills as installable units: Salesforce's Winter '27 release, GA Oct 12, ships 100+ prebuilt Agent Skills in a shared registry and plug-ins that bundle skills with MCP connectors, hooks and config. It also lets Agentforce orchestrate, or act as a subagent to, A2A-compliant agents from AWS, Azure and Google.
Capture beyond the video call: Reevo's mobile app (Oct 12) records and transcribes in-person meetings and calls from a phone without a meeting bot, then updates the deal and drafts the follow-up.

biggest_ai_news.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300 and makes Maia its main inference system
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 12: multi-gigawatt Maia deployments from 2027; Microsoft claims 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems. Maia 200 already serves Copilot, with GitHub Copilot and Foundry to follow by year-end.

biggest_ai_news.title: Nvidia in early talks to buy or deepen its stake in Reflection AI
biggest_ai_news.body: FT, Sat Oct 10: options include an acqui-hire, more chips or a bigger stake; Nvidia has already invested $800M. Talks could collapse. Reflection released its open-weight Beam model Oct 5.

biggest_ai_news.title: AMD introduces Helion, a rack blueprint for agent workloads
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 12: OCP-based racks with CPU-only (up to 32,768 cores) or CPU+GPU configurations and a built-in token router across frontier and open models. Partner configurations planned for November 2026.

what_changed.title: Salesforce signs a definitive agreement to acquire Loops
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist). Oct 12: Loops monitors KPIs, explains why metrics move and suggests actions; it can be triggered from Slack and email. Team and technology go into Tableau; close expected early November. Price not disclosed (Ctech estimates about $30M). Why it matters: Salesforce is adding 'explain why, then act' analytics agents next to Agentforce, its second agent-company deal in two weeks after Listen Labs (Sep 29).

what_changed.title: Salesforce Winter '27 reaches general availability
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist). Oct 12 per Salesforce: Agent Skills and Plugins (100+ prebuilt skills; Salesforce Development plug-in in the Claude Code marketplace), Third-Party Agent Orchestration over A2A, Slack Code, Marketing Goals Agent (pilot). Trailhead highlights list Agent Optimizer in Agentforce Builder, Hunter and Momentum (call and email capture into Salesforce). No GA flag or pricing found yet for Agent Optimizer or AI Skills in Coworker.

what_changed.title: Qobra's sales-comp MCP goes native in Dust with write actions
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 12: 45 read and 20 write actions (users, quotas, plans, records, reports, requests), scoped to the user's Qobra permissions, writes tagged as MCP in the audit trail; statements and payouts are off-limits to agents. Doctolib named as a production user. The same MCP server works with Claude and ChatGPT.

what_changed.title: Reevo launches a mobile app for bot-free conversation capture
what_changed.body: NEW (optional watchlist). Oct 12: account briefings before meetings, phone recording and transcription of in-person meetings and calls, automatic summaries, deal updates and follow-up drafts, routing of pricing and security questions to colleagues, badge and business-card scanning.

what_changed.title: Hiver launches Hiver Omni, an agentic omnichannel support platform
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 12: AI agents investigate and work multi-step requests across connected systems; email, chat, Slack, voice and WhatsApp in one workspace; resolutions feed knowledge updates, quality review and account signals. Available now.

quiet_note: No net-new product PR Oct 10–12 from Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco (Clay's Oct 12 X post recapped Sculpt; Outreach's Oct 12 blog post is content marketing). Aged off Today: Clay Sculpt launches, Microsoft's 30 Dynamics 365 CRM skills, Google Gemini agent, Hone seed, Outreach Forrester TEI, Anthropic OSS Scanner, OpenAI GPT-6 Intelligent UI expansion (all Oct 8); OpenAI firing of three safety researchers (Oct 9). watch.title: Salesforce's October GAs: Agent Optimizer and AI Skills
watch.body: Winter '27 went GA Oct 12, but Salesforce has not publicly confirmed the GA flag or pricing for Agent Optimizer (beta through account executives since Sep 21) or AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker (pilot), both promised for October '26. Hunter stays in pilot until November. Watch release notes and the newsroom for status and Flex Credit pricing before month-end.

interpretation.fact: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Loops (Oct 12) and its Winter '27 release reached GA (Oct 12). Qobra's MCP went native in Dust (Oct 12). Reevo launched a mobile app and Hiver launched Hiver Omni (Oct 12). Microsoft announced Maia 300 (Oct 12). The FT reported Nvidia in talks over Reflection AI (Oct 10). AMD introduced Helion (Oct 12).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: vendors now ship agent write access with the controls built in (user-scoped permissions, audit tags, protected fields) rather than as read-only copilots. Salesforce's Loops deal is small and lands in Tableau, so its direct effect on sales workflows depends on how it surfaces in Agentforce and Slack after close.
